intro: The Genesys V2 Dresser stands strong beneath daily routines. With scratch-resistant finishes and seamless storage, it’s where beauty meets function.

features.title: Surface that stays spotless
features.text: Our melamine-treated lamination resists stains and scratches—so it stays sharp through daily use.

features.title: We built it to handle real life
features.text: The surface resists scratches and stains, so you can style it, use it, and clean it—without worrying about everyday wear.

features.title: No sharp edges, no worries
features.text: Our SAFEDGE banding ensures smooth, rounded corners—making it ideal for homes with little ones or high-traffic use.

features.title: Drawers that glide, not jam
features.text: Our wide drawers open smoothly every time, giving you easy access to your daily essentials.

features.title: We make moving and assembling easier
features.text: With a knockdown construction, our dresser is simple to transport and reassemble—so it fits your space and your lifestyle with ease.

name: Genesys V2 Premium Dresser
